from __future__ import annotations
import base64,csv,hashlib,io,json,zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/private/tmp/fq-integrated-wheel-evidence-20261122')
verification=json.loads((ROOT/'archive-verification.json').read_text())
artifact_path=Path(verification['verified_path'])
run=json.loads((ROOT/'github-run.json').read_text())
artifact=json.loads((ROOT/'github-artifacts.json').read_text())['artifacts'][0]
assert run['status']=='completed' and run['conclusion']=='success' and run['run_attempt']==1
with artifact_path.open('rb') as stream:assert hashlib.file_digest(stream,'sha256').hexdigest()==artifact['digest'].split(':',1)[1]
expected={'first':'11745ab11070765974b90f5a8f512bf4c30576b1','second':'dce3948b946906875a759362e8570b22a8214d5f'}
roles={};admissions=[]
with zipfile.ZipFile(artifact_path) as archive:
 joint=json.loads(archive.read('joint-development-check.json'))
 assert joint['matched_non_frontend_inputs'] and joint['distinct_interpreters']
 assert not joint['entropy_drawn'] and not joint['campaign_executed'] and not joint['publication_eligible']
 for role,revision in expected.items():
  build=json.loads(archive.read(role+'/build/build.json'))
  assert build['source_commit']==revision and build['returncode']==0 and build['independent_attestation'] is False
  for field in ('source_archive','wheel','log'):
   name=role+'/build/'+build[field]['filename']
   with archive.open(name) as stream:digest=hashlib.file_digest(stream,'sha256').hexdigest()
   assert digest==build[field]['sha256'],name
  source_data=archive.read(role+'/build/'+build['source_archive']['filename'])
  wheel_data=archive.read(role+'/build/'+build['wheel']['filename'])
  with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(source_data)) as source,zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(wheel_data)) as wheel:
   assert source.comment.decode()==revision
   names=wheel.namelist();record=next(n for n in names if n.endswith('.dist-info/RECORD') and len(n.split('/'))==2)
   verified_files=0
   for name,digest,size in csv.reader(io.StringIO(wheel.read(record).decode())):
    if not digest:
     assert name==record and not size
     continue
    kind,wanted=digest.split('=',1);assert kind=='sha256'
    data=wheel.read(name)
    assert base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hashlib.sha256(data).digest()).decode().rstrip('=')==wanted
    assert len(data)==int(size)
    verified_files+=1
   sources={}
   for name in ('flagquantum/compiler/optimization/one_qubit_optimization.py','flagquantum/compiler/optimization/two_qubit_optimization.py'):
    matches=[n for n in source.namelist() if n == name or n.endswith('/'+name)];assert len(matches)==1
    assert source.read(matches[0])==wheel.read(name)
    sources[name]=hashlib.sha256(wheel.read(name)).hexdigest()
  xml=ET.fromstring(archive.read(role+'/conformance.xml'));suites=xml.findall('.//testsuite');assert len(suites)==1
  suite=suites[0];assert {k:int(suite.attrib[k]) for k in ('tests','failures','errors','skipped')}=={'tests':12,'failures':0,'errors':0,'skipped':0}
  testcases=suite.findall('testcase');assert len(testcases)==12 and all(len(case)==0 for case in testcases)
  admission=json.loads(archive.read(role+'/development-admissions.json'));admissions.append(admission)
  assert not admission['entropy_drawn'] and not admission['publication_eligible']
  assert set(admission['registrations'])=={'flagquantum-ordinary-restored','flagquantum-target-artifact'}
  assert next(d['version'] for d in admission['inventory']['dependencies'] if d['name']=='torch')=='2.14.0+cpu'
  roles[role]={'source_commit':revision,'build_returncode':build['returncode'],'source_archive':build['source_archive'],'wheel':build['wheel'],'build_log':build['log'],'source_archive_commit_comment_verified':True,'wheel_record_payloads_verified':verified_files,'packaged_optimization_source_sha256':sources,'testcases':[{'name':case.attrib['name'],'seconds':float(case.attrib['time'])} for case in testcases],'selected_tests':12,'failures':0,'errors':0,'skipped':0,'independent_build_attestation':False}
 assert admissions[0]['interpreter']['python']!=admissions[1]['interpreter']['python']
 assert admissions[0]['interpreter']['executable_sha256']==admissions[1]['interpreter']['executable_sha256']
raw_records=[]
with zipfile.ZipFile(artifact_path) as archive:
 for name in verification['extracted_small_records']:
  data=archive.read(name);raw_records.append({'member':name,'bytes':len(data),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})

execution_profile.smt: Do not share the measured physical core with an active sibling; record the actual SMT policy.
execution_profile.host_identity: The same physical host and immutable image for every stack in a cohort; exact CPU model/OS/kernel/BIOS, clocks and dependencies must be sealed in the run manifest before any participant timing.
execution_profile.process_memory_limit: Per-case cap, maximum 16 GiB including SDK-owned child processes.
execution_profile.stochastic_seed_rule: Take first 8 bytes of SHA256("sdkbench-first-wave:0.1-candidate-1:<instance>:<block>:<context>") modulo 2**32; block is 0..9; context is 0-based fixture order. Same integers requested of participants, not the same RNG stream.

supervisor-qualification.json.scope: Resource positive/negative controls only; not participant measurement or host exclusivity certification

installed-native-conformance.json.scope: Host-local installed-wheel semantic conformance; not measurement

declaration.admission: No measured campaign until public freeze, unchanged inputs, all existing tasks drained, reserved labels verified, host baseline sealed and selected core/sibling idle. Fail closed on missing evidence.
declaration.stopping_rule: One full attempt; preserve all 120 blocks and 360 measured records plus 240 warmups, including failures. No favorable rerun. On interruption retain every partial output; no release claim.

results.status: Completed first measured campaign; independent replay accepted all twelve cases

private_host_diagnostics.scope: Raw process inventories retained privately; excluded from public archive. No indefinite availability claim.

independent_replay.scope: independent record replay; build attestation and publication review remain separate

metric_notes: Counts and dependency depth are recomputed by the independent evaluator.
Timing uses the median of three accepted measurements within each accepted block.
Quartiles use inclusive linear interpolation across observed values.
Incomplete or warmup-failed blocks contribute no timing median; all records remain counted.
Memory includes the whole supervised block: imports, warmups, measurements and export.
Accepted-record statistics in a failed case are conditional diagnostics, not case success.
Six-qubit semantics use the full operator; larger frozen cases use only three probes.
Restored-layout and free-final-layout workflows are different end-to-end contracts.
No optimality, global ranking or qualified publication-host claim is made.
results.interruption: Measurement completed before session interruption. Original replay log was empty with no result. Retained interruption record, successful separately named replay recovery, and successful official report replay. No measurement rerun.
results.host_observation: No foreign CI in measured heartbeats; late post-run baseline matches packages and stable files. Observation gap after interrupted replay prevents continuous host-attestation claim.
results.runner_restoration: All sixteen original scheduling label sets restored; exact record included in archive. No process or service restart or termination.
limitations: Inspected historical controls; not unseen applications or a global ranking.
Six-wire full operator; eight/twelve wires only three full-state probes.
Artifact path includes validation, provenance and serialization; ordinary path does not.
Private default CPython build without PGO/LTO; observed times conditional on frozen environment.
Full local default tier did not pass; historical-origin failure and disk-related setup errors remain disclosed.
Original PR metadata failures preserved; fixed only evidence representation.
